items.title: Tata Motors PV shares crack 9% as Motilal Oswal cuts earnings estimates, stays bearish after Q2 results
items.description: TMPV Share Price: Tata Motors PV reported a consolidated net loss in Q2FY27, partly due to a one-time charge, while revenue grew 34% year-on-year. Brokerages remain cautious amid persistent pressure on Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) and margin concerns. Motilal Oswal reiterated its Sell rating, while 360 One WAM downgraded the stock to Hold, cutting its target price.
